article.title: Parties to appear on day fixed in summons for defendant to appear and answer.
article.content: On the day fixed in the summons for the defendant to appear and answer, the parties shall be in attendance at the Court-house in person or by their respective pleaders, and the suit shall then be heard unless the hearing is adjourned to a future day fixed by the Court.
article.html:
1Parties to appear on day fixed in summons for defendant to appear and answer.

Order 9, Rule 1

On the day fixed in the summons for the defendant to appear and answer, the parties shall be in attendance at the Court-house in person or by their respective pleaders, and the suit shall then be heard unless the hearing is adjourned to a future day fixed by the Court.
